name: taller-api-pruebas
description: Pruebas de API del taller (Petstore) con Newman, para ejecutar en Jenkins

scripts.test:datos: newman run "postman/Taller Petstore.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/Petstore - QA.postman_environment.json" --env-var "apiKey=special-key" --folder "Datos desde archivo" -d datos/mascotas.csv
scripts.test:allure: newman run "postman/Taller Petstore.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/Petstore - QA.postman_environment.json" --env-var "apiKey=special-key" --folder "CRUD Mascota" -r cli,allure --reporter-allure-export allure-results
